title: Lost Vape Galaxy S360 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Lost Vape Galaxy S360 brings the series’ distinctive 360-degree Galaxy LED wrap to a pocket-friendly box design. It’s draw-activated for simple use and powered by an impressive 1400mAh built-in battery with an adjustable 5–35W range. Single Mesh and Dual Mesh modes let you tune warmth and vapour to suit your preference. Around the chassis, more than 300 micro-LEDs create a dazzling continuous status display that’s visible from any angle. A small multi-function button provides quick shortcuts for screen wake, power saving and power on/off, so it’s easy to check and manage the device at a glance. The kit pairs with a 2ml URSA V3 top-fill pod fitted with an integrated 0.8ohm mesh coil, ideal for 50/50 freebase or nicotine salt e-liquids. An airflow slider lets you set a tighter mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw or open things up for a looser restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) inhale. The S360 is cross-compatible with URSA V1 and V2 pods, giving you more resistance and draw options without changing device. USB-C charging and a lanyard complete the everyday setup. Browse our vape juice and find the perfect flavour to match this kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
